Submariner-style hands with Mercedes. It's the Sea-Dweller 116600 (Sea-Dweller 4000, 40mm, 2014-2017) or the newer 126600 (43mm, with cyclops lens and "Sea-Dweller" in red). The 126600 has a cyclops over the date and red Sea-Dweller text on dial — yes, ref 126600 has red "Sea-Dweller" word. The 116600 has white "Sea-Dweller" text? Actually 116600 has "SEA-DWELLER" in white? Let me recall: Rolex Sea-Dweller 4000 116600 (2014) has "SEA-DWELLER" printed in white, and no cyclops. The 126600 (2017) 43mm has a cyclops lens, red "SEA-DWELLER" text, and 1220m = 4000ft depth rating. Here 1220m matches both (both are 1220m). But the cyclops is present here, so it's the 126600.

Wait — 116600 depth is 1220 m too. Yes both 4000ft/1220m. But cyclops → 126600. Also 126600 has red Sea-Dweller text (this photo shows red "SEA-DWELLER"). So ref 126600.

Also 126600 has the "Sea-Dweller" red line and the date with cyclops. Yes.

Reference: 126600-0001 (black dial, Oyster bracelet). Steel. Automatic. Bracelet metal (Oyster steel).

Confidence moderate-high, 0.85.
